title: Model registry prompt tag detection: the prompt path is selected only when the effective mlflow.prompt.is_prompt value is 'true'
answers: A model version tagged mlflow.prompt.is_prompt=false is being checked as a prompt and rejected for its source path, why?
Why did adding a duplicate is_prompt tag change which validation ran on create model version?
Where does the server decide whether a model version create request is a prompt?
body:
Path: mlflow/server/handlers.py:_is_prompt_request reads the request's tags list and decides in mlflow/server/handlers.py:_create_model_version whether a CreateModelVersion request takes the prompt branch (prompt source validation, skipping run and model source checks) or the regular model-version branch.
Rule: Collapse request tags into a dict keyed by tag key with the last value winning, then test tags.get(IS_PROMPT_TAG_KEY, "false").lower() == "true". This mirrors ModelVersion._is_prompt. Do not use any() over the tag keys, because the mere presence of the key used to select the prompt path.
Symptom: A create request tagged mlflow.prompt.is_prompt=false was routed through the prompt branch, which skipped _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model. With duplicate tags [true, false], the handler took the prompt path (and its validation and webhook path) while the persisted entity was not a prompt.
Constraints: Only the value "true" in any letter case selects the prompt path; "false", "0", "" and a final "false" after "true" all fall through to regular model-version source validation. The check looks only at IS_PROMPT_TAG_KEY. Clients that set the tag to true are unaffected.
applies: Detection of prompt versus regular model version for CreateModelVersion requests received over the REST API.
says: Setting the prompt tag to false still treats the registered model as a prompt.
Regular models are unexpectedly rejected by prompt source validation when explicitly marked not prompts.
Duplicate prompt labels cause standard model source verification to be skipped during creation.
Ensure models with false prompt metadata undergo normal model validation rules.
A model marked with false prompt status triggers invalid prompt errors upon creation.
search: In _is_prompt_request, prompt routing for CreateModelVersion requests is triggered only when the case-insensitive value of IS_PROMPT_TAG_KEY evaluates to true after collapsing duplicate tags with last-value-wins. Checking for tag key presence rather than checking the final tag value caused requests with false or empty values to bypass standard model source validation. Only the string true selects the prompt validation path, while values like false, 0, or empty fall through to _validate_source_run and _validate_source_model.
